digo_source: Mgombato ('chikatsu turmeric'; 'mandano turmeric'; 'rangi ya mandano' = yellow)

teaser.en: In Digo, the word for turmeric, *mandano*, is also the word for the colour yellow.
teaser.sw: Kwa Kidigo, neno la manjano (kiungo), *mandano*, ndilo pia neno la rangi ya manjano.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Chidigo, *mandano* ni chikatsu, na piya ni neno ra rangi: *rangi ya mandano*, ambayo kpwa Chingereza ni *yellow*.

summary.en: *Chikatsu* or *mandano* is turmeric, a root spice that gives coastal dishes their golden colour. It is cooked with pigeon peas, potatoes and fish in coconut sauce, and used in cosmetics and medicine.
summary.sw: *Chikatsu* au *mandano* ni manjano, kiungo cha kiazi kinachoipa milo ya pwani rangi yake ya dhahabu. Hupikwa pamoja na mbaazi, viazi na samaki katika mchuzi wa nazi, na hutumika katika vipodozi na dawa.
summary.dg: *Chikatsu* au *mandano* (kpwa Chingereza *turmeric*) ni muzi unaotiywa vyakurya, unaopha vyakurya vya pwani rangi ya zahabu. Chinajitwa na mbalazi, viazi na ng'onda wa mtsuzi wa nazi, na chinahumirwa kpwa vitu vya kudzipamba na kpwa dawa.

about.en: Turmeric is a leafy plant of the ginger family with large, broad leaves. The part used is the rhizome, an underground stem that is knobbly and brown outside and a bright orange-yellow inside. It stains fingers, cloth and food alike.
about.sw: Manjano ni mmea wenye majani mengi wa familia ya tangawizi, wenye majani makubwa mapana. Sehemu inayotumika ni kiazi chake, shina la chini ya ardhi lenye vifundo, la kahawia kwa nje na la rangi ya machungwa-manjano inayong'aa kwa ndani. Huacha madoa kwenye vidole, nguo na chakula vilevile.
about.dg: *Chikatsu* ni mmea wenye makodza manji wa jamii ya tangawizi, wenye makodza makulu mapana. Seemu inayohumirwa ni *rhizome*, muhi urio tsini ya ulongo; kondze una maugu na ni wa rangi ya dongo, na ndani ni wa rangi ya chungbwa na mandano inayong'ala. Chikatsu chinaika rangiye kpwenye vyala, nguwo na vyakurya.

where.en: Most turmeric used on the south coast is bought rather than grown.
where.sw: Sehemu kubwa ya manjano yanayotumika katika pwani ya kusini hununuliwa badala ya kupandwa.
where.dg: Chikatsu chinachohumirwa pwani ya kusini, chinji nkugulwa, si kurimwa.

uses.en: Turmeric goes into pigeon peas, potatoes and fish cooked in coconut sauce, giving them their colour. It is also used in cosmetics and in medicine.
uses.sw: Manjano hutiwa katika mbaazi, viazi na samaki wanaopikwa kwa mchuzi wa nazi, na kuwapa rangi yao. Pia hutumika katika vipodozi na kama dawa.
uses.dg: Chikatsu nkutiywa mbalazi, viazi na ng'onda anaojitwa kpwa mtsuzi wa nazi, na ndicho chinachovipha rangi. Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa vitu vya kudzipamba na kpwa dawa.

culture.en: Turmeric gave its name to a colour: *rangi ya mandano*, 'the colour of turmeric', means yellow. The word *mandano* also names yellow fever.
culture.sw: Manjano yalitoa jina lake kwa rangi: *rangi ya mandano*, 'rangi ya manjano (kiungo)', maana yake ni rangi ya manjano. Neno *mandano* pia hutaja homa ya manjano.
culture.dg: Dzina ra chikatsu rakala dzina ra rangi: *rangi ya mandano*, 'rangi ya chikatsu', ni rangi ya *yellow*. Neno *mandano* piya ni dzina ra homa ya *yellow fever*.

names.en: Digo has two words for turmeric: *chikatsu* and *mandano*. Swahili calls it *manjano*, which also means yellow. In English it is turmeric.
names.sw: Kidigo kina maneno mawili ya manjano (kiungo): *chikatsu* na *mandano*. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *manjano*, ambalo pia lina maana ya rangi ya manjano. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *turmeric*.
names.dg: Chidigo china maneno mairi ga mmea huno: *chikatsu* na *mandano*. Chiswahili chinachiiha *manjano*, neno ambaro piya ni ra rangi ya *yellow*. Kpwa Chingereza chinaihwa *turmeric*.

reason.sw: Wa familia moja; iliki, kiungo kingine cha pwani
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga; iliki, chitu chanjina cha kujitira cha pwani.

reason.en: Another plant used to colour and for cosmetics
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotumika kutia rangi na katika vipodozi
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaohumirwa kutiya rangi na kpwa vitu vya kudzipamba.

sources: Mwalonya, Nicolle, Nicolle & Zimbu, Mgombato: Digo-English-Swahili Dictionary (BTL / Digo Language and Literacy Project, 2004; e-version 2005)
